messages:
sophia: Heads-up — opened docs PR to add a "Drift detection" section to model cards for catalog models. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

alex: Nice. Is this the section that will suggest thresholds, sample prompts, and an SDK snippet for alerting?

sophia: Yep. Plan is: short explanation, recommended metrics (token distribution shift, response length, perplexity proxy), example thresholds, a tiny eval prompt set, and an SDK+Console wiring snippet. Need reviewers for wording + examples.

jeff: I'll take benchmarks/threshold wording. Quick thought: use both KL-divergence on token probs and a simple embedding drift fallback. Suggest thresholds: KL>0.25 as warning, >0.6 for critical (tunable).

nina: For Console/Optimize wiring, we should show a snippet that uses the SDK to push metrics and then define an alert in Console. I'll add a TODO for the Console UI screenshot replacement.

liam: Link check: the PR currently points to the old "monitoring.md" anchor. I'll patch links to "observability/drift" in the docs nav. Also will add a short note about sampling windows (24h vs 7d).

_docs-bot: PR 512 created by sophia — labels: docs, model-catalog, monitoring. CI: docs-lint ✅  build-preview pending._

sophia: Putting a minimal SDK snippet in the PR — can ppl sanity-check? (goal: show pushing a drift metric)

sophia: ```py
from redwood import MetricsClient
mc = MetricsClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
mc.push_metric(
  model_id="nebula3b", metric_name="token_kl",
  value=0.32, tags={"env":"prod","window":"24h"}
)
```

alex: snippet looks fine, maybe add rate limiting note and example of batching metrics.

jeff: Also add a short example of embedding drift fallback routing in runtime policy, e.g. if drift critical -> route to smaller model + alert.

nina: For the Console section, recommend: show how to create an alert on metric > threshold, then a runbook link. I'll draft the screenshot placeholder and the runbook blurb.

sophia: Thanks. If we can get reviews from jeff + nina + liam today I can merge and then follow up with the preview link for engineering to test.

liam: Reviewing now, will push a tiny linkfix PR to your branch.

jeff: LGTM for wording, left one comment about clarifying "perplexity proxy" computation.

nina: LGTM for Console wiring. Left nit on phrasing.

sophia: great — merging after CI completes. I'll post the preview link here once generated :rocket:

_docs-bot: PR 512 updated — status: build-preview available at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/512_

sophia: Preview up. Please spot-check the examples and link anchors. If no objections I'll merge at EOD.

alex: Spot-checked embed drift example, looks good :+1:

liam: Fixed one broken anchor in the nav, pushed to the branch.

jeff: One last nit addressed — approved.

sophia: Merged. Thanks everyone! Will open a short follow-up to add a small eval prompt pack to examples/.

nina: Thanks, great to have this in model cards :eyes:
